newsitem.title: USA: Fidelity Brokerage Group chief to retire.
newsitem.headline: Fidelity Brokerage Group chief to retire.

text.p: Fidelity Investments said Tuesday that Sherif Nada, head of the institutional brokerage unit Fidelity Brokerage Group (FBG), will retire on Aug. 1.
Nada, 55, will be succeeded by Kenneth Rathgeber, 49, who is currently acting president of Fidelity Brokerage Services, the British-based brokerage unit that is part of FBG.

Rathberger will also succeed Nada on Fidelity's operating committee. Nada will remain a senior vice president of Fidelity's parent company, FMR Corp., reporting to Gary Burkhead, vice chairman of FMR Corp. and chief executive of Fidelity Institutional Group.
